horizon: 7 exchange trading sessions inclusive; admission session is index 1; session 7 EOD is final signal evaluation
suspension: exchange session advances age; no entry evaluation; pure suspension is not hard invalidation
overlap: one ACTIVE or SIGNALLED instance per security; new admission only after terminal state on a later session
pending_execution: SIGNALLED remains pending for EXECUTION_UNRESOLVED within the seven-session horizon; exchange-session age still advances, no new EOD signal before resolution, and an unresolved instance expires at session 7 EOD
no_fill: ACTIVE if signal session <7, otherwise EXPIRED
modelled_fill: TERMINATED_AFTER_FILL boundary only; no position implementation
